book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: How had Fogg reached Yokohama?
The Tankadere had reached Shanghai on time.

sentences.ar: بس الباخرة الأمريكية كانت طالعة، بعيدة، بنص البحر.
sentences.en: But the American steamer had sailed, far off, in mid-sea.
And Fogg said to Bunsby: raise the flag.
And fire the cannon.
The distress flag.
And the steamer saw, and stopped, and took them.

sentences.ar: وفوغ دفع لبونسبي المية جنيه، والمئتين، وزيادة.
sentences.en: And Fogg paid Bunsby the hundred, and the two hundred, and more.
And said: an excellent captain.

sentences.ar: وعلى الباخرة، فوغ لعودا: لازم نلاقي باسبارتو بيوكوهاما.
sentences.en: And on the steamer, Fogg to Aouda: we must find Passepartout in Yokohama.
Aouda said: and if he is not there?
Fogg said: he will be there.
And in Yokohama, Fogg went to the consulate.
No.
And to the police.
No.
And to the Carnatic.
Yes, he had been aboard.
And got off.
And where had he gone?
No one knew.
And Aouda said: let us walk through the city.
And they saw the troupe's sign, and went in.

sentences.ar: والباخرة الجنرال غرانت طلعت الساعة ستة ونص.
sentences.en: And the steamer General Grant sailed at half past six.
With Fogg, Aouda, and Passepartout aboard.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو بتياب بهلوان، ولسا عليه ريحة الخشب.
sentences.en: And Passepartout in acrobat's clothes, still smelling of wood.
And he told Aouda everything.
But about Fix, he said nothing.
Because he did not want to upset his master.
And Fix?
He was on the steamer too.
But hid in his cabin.
And one day, on deck, Passepartout saw him.
And without a word, hit him.
One blow, and Fix fell.

sentences.ar: وقام، ومسح دم من أنفه، وقال: خلصت؟
sentences.en: And got up, wiped blood from his nose, and said: finished?
Passepartout said: for now.
Fix said: fine.
Listen.
Until now, I was against your master.
Because on English soil, I could stop him.

sentences.ar: بس من هلق، بأمريكا، ما إلي سلطة.
sentences.en: But from now, in America, I have no authority.

sentences.ar: فبدي إياه يرجع لإنجلترا بأسرع وقت.
sentences.en: So I want him back in England as fast as possible.
Like you.
From today, I am with him.
And Passepartout looked at him, and said: fine.
But if you change your mind, I strangle you.
